POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE AGENDA
  MONDAY, JULY 27, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Patricia Scott, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to homelessservicesadmin@longbeach.gov

  For information on how to participate in this meeting, please visit:
  https://www.longbeach.gov/homelessness/volunteer-donate-and-get-involved/#committee

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55551  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Homeless Services
  Policy Subcommittee meeting of Monday, May 11, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55552  Recommendation to review and approve a proposal for a $50,000 budget plan for
  the Mayor’s Fund pilot hygiene project and submit the proposal to the Mayor and
  City Council with funding provided through the Mayor’s Fund.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55553  Recommendation to discuss strategies around engaging the public on Homeless
  Services Initiatives.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55554  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Policy Subcommittee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
two minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
